tools.name: get_brand_profile
tools.description: Official profile of this brand: name, description, tagline, contact details, website, social profiles, main location and the actions available (request an audit, contact, book a meeting). Use it first to know who the brand is.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search the products, services and catalogue items (property listings, vehicles in stock, shop products) this brand officially offers. Filter by words, kind, sector, category, price range and sector attributes (city, bedrooms, make, year, mileage...). Returns name, summary, price, URL and, for catalo

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Full details of one product, service or catalogue item of this brand, by the id returned by search_offers: description, price, availability, status (active, reserved, sold), all attributes and photos, URL, when it was last updated and current promotions for it.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Offices, shops or service points of this brand: address, city, country, phone, email and opening hours. Optionally filter by city.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Answer a question about this brand with its own published FAQs, policies, case studies and facts. Returns the matching entries with their source URL. Base your answer only on them; if nothing matches, say the brand has not published that information.

tools.name: get_promotions
tools.description: Promotions and discounts of this brand that are valid today, with their conditions, dates and codes. Expired or future promotions are not returned.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The professional services this company offers to other businesses: what each one is, its category, published price (if any) and the page to learn more. Use it when someone asks what the company does or which service fits their need.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Published client cases and success stories of this company, with what was done and the results it reports, and the page where each one is published. Optionally filter by a word (client, sector or service). Quote results only as the company states them.

tools.name: request_audit
tools.description: Ask this company for an audit of the user's website. First call with the user's details: you get a summary and a privacy notice to show them. Only after they confirm, call again with confirm_token to send it. Never send without explicit confirmation.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Ask this company to contact the user (by email or phone) about something. First call with the user's details and message: you get a summary and a privacy notice to show them. Only after they confirm, call again with confirm_token to send it.

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description: Request a meeting with this company. First call with the user's details: you get a summary and a privacy notice to show them. Only after they confirm, call again with confirm_token to send it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "botpasslabs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_offers, get_offer, list_locations, request_contact · Private data: get_brand_profile, request_contact · Public sink: list_locations, request_audit, request_contact, book_meeting.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_offers, get_offer, list_locations, request_contact · Private data: get_brand_profile, request_contact · Public sink: list_locations, request_audit, request_contact, book_meeting

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
